description: Header file defining internal memory string utility functions for the Abseil C++ library, including mem* functions like memcat, memcasecmp, memdup, and internal matching templates.

methods.name: memcat
methods.description: Concatenates memory block src to dest at position destlen.

methods.name: memcasecmp
methods.description: Performs case-insensitive comparison of two memory blocks.

methods.name: memrchr
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a character in a memory block.

methods.name: memspn
methods.description: Calculates the length of the initial segment of s consisting only of accept characters.

methods.name: memcspn
methods.description: Calculates the length of the initial segment of s consisting only of reject characters.

methods.name: mempbrk
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence in s of any character from accept.

methods.name: int_memmatch
methods.description: Internal template for memory substring matching, case-sensitive or insensitive.

methods.name: memmem
methods.description: Finds a substring in memory with specified length (case-sensitive).

methods.name: memcasemem
methods.description: Finds a substring in memory with specified length (case-insensitive).

methods.name: memmatch
methods.description: Fast case-sensitive memory match with few possible matches.
